title: Investor unease builds entering war's fifth week - The Business Times
summary: The ongoing Middle East conflict, particularly the Iran war, has led to significant market volatility, with the Nasdaq 100 entering a 10% correction and the S&P 500 falling 8.8% below its January record. Crude oil prices hit a record high amidst escalating tensions, impacting global markets and consumer sentiment.
sentiment_reason: The escalation of the Iran war and the resulting high oil prices are causing strong negative sentiment in the markets, as indicated by the significant declines in stock indices and the prediction of continued volatility.
